One continuous shot with no cuts, no flashes, no dissolves and no added effects. Start exactly on the first photo and end exactly on the second photo. The same happy little boy is in both photos, a little older in the second. Right away he laughs, turns and runs off down the sidewalk, and a steady camera follows him. While he runs away with his back to the camera, everything changes together in one smooth moment: the sidewalk turns into the playroom of the second photo, the superhero outfit and the mask turn into the second photo's outfit, and he grows a little older. When he turns around and runs back toward the camera, he is already fully in the second photo's outfit, with no mask and no cape, in the playroom. He comes close to the camera, steps back and settles, smiling at the camera, into the second photo's pose and place. The motion never stops at the change. His face stays one clear face whenever it is visible, never doubled or see-through. In each photo he looks exactly as in that photo (face, eyes, hairline); no cape at any time. The last frame is the second photo. No people or text that are not in the photos.
